title: MoneyB**ch
description: kill players, earn money, buy gear, roll teams. simple money smp plugin
body:
MoneyBitch is a simple Money SMP plugin for Paper 1.21. Players start with $100, get $10 per kill, and spend it at a GUI shop. Teams get rolled with a slot-machine animation. That's pretty much it.

how it works
everyone spawns with $100. kill someone → +$10, it shows up in chat for the whole server. spend your money at /shop on gear and food. your balance shows in tab and above your head at all times.

shop prices
itempriceBread$5Cooked Beef$8Golden Apple$40Enchanted Golden Apple$150Iron Sword$20Diamond Sword$80Iron Armor (full set)$72Diamond Armor (full set)$290Bow$30Arrows x8$1Shield$25

teams
do /rollteams 2 5 and every player gets a title screen that spins through random team colors before landing on their actual team. supports up to 8 teams (red, blue, green, yellow, purple, orange, aqua, pink). team shows in nametag + tab.
